definitions.explanation: The number seven. Like four, seven has two readings: なな and しち. なな is more commonly used in everyday counting because しち can be confused with いち (one) or し (four) when spoken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七|なな}⟦{日|にち}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{七|なな}{月|がつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to Japan in July.
examples.notes: しちがつ is also correct

examples.japanese: ⟦{七|しち}{月|がつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{暑|あつ}く→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: July is the beginning of summer, and it gets very hot every day.
examples.notes: {七|しち}{月|がつ} uses the しち reading

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{七|なな}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝|あさ}ごはん→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べます→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。⟦それから→それから：00996_sorekara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I wake up at seven in the morning, wash my face, and then eat breakfast. Then I go to school.

notes:
{七|なな} has two readings: なな (native Japanese) and しち (Sino-Japanese). なな is preferred in most spoken contexts because しち can be confused with ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) or ⟦{四|し}→四：00767_yon⟧ (four).

WHEN TO USE EACH READING:
- なな: safer in most situations, especially when counting aloud
- しち: used in set expressions like ⟦{七|しち}{月|がつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧ (July), ⟦{七|しち}{五|ご}{三|さん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧ (Shichi-Go-San festival)
- Either: {七|なな/しち}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (seven o'clock) — both are common

COUNTER COMBINATIONS:
- {七|なな}つ: seven things (native counter)
- {七|なな}⟦{人|にん}→人：00658_nin⟧: seven people
- {七|なな}⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: seven long objects
- {七|なな}{冊|さつ}: seven books
- {七|なな}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧: seven hundred

CULTURAL:
- ⟦{七|しち}{五|ご}{三|さん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧: festival celebrating children aged 7, 5, and 3 (November 15)
- {七|しち}{福神|ふくじん}: the Seven Lucky Gods
- ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧: Star Festival (July 7th — note the special reading)
